title: Collections Desk Guide, Retail Installment Contracts: Installments a Hardship Extension Agreement Defers
content:
**Clause.** A hardship extension agreement on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts defers the smallest of:

- **one** installment;
- the tier's maximum installments deferred by one extension;
- the tier's maximum installments deferred per rolling 12 months, less the installments deferred by extensions effective in the rolling 12 months; and
- the tier's maximum installments deferred over the life of the contract, less the installments deferred by every earlier extension of the contract,

and never fewer than zero.

**Assembly.** Where further allowances are set, the agreement defers the smallest of the tier limits and every allowance set, never fewer than zero, and when that smallest figure is zero no agreement is offered.

**The figures read.** The tier limits are the per-request, 12-month and lifetime extension maximums of the contract's tier. The installments deferred in the rolling 12 months are the installments of every extension whose effective date is later than the same calendar day 12 months before the signing date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) and on or before it; the lifetime figure counts every extension ever granted on the contract.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier limits)

| Case | Per request | 12-month maximum less deferred in 12 months | Lifetime maximum less deferred to date | Installments deferred |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 2 | 3 less 1, that is 2 | 6 less 2, that is 4 | smallest of 1, 2, 2 and 4: **1** |
| B | 2 | 2 less 2, that is 0 | 4 less 2, that is 2 | smallest of 1, 2, 0 and 2: **0**, so no agreement is offered |
| C | 1 | 2 less 0, that is 2 | 3 less 3, that is 0 | **0**, so no agreement is offered |

A figure below zero — for instance a lifetime maximum of 4 against 5 installments already deferred — gives minus 1 for that limit, and the agreement then defers zero.
